SECTION 1

* Young people are often unfairly judged by older generations for spending their money on small enjoyments like eating out and holidays instead of saving.
* It is extremely difficult for young adults to buy houses today due to high property prices, a lack of available homes, and strict bank loan rules.
* Many young people feel trapped in a cycle of renting forever, paying their hard-earned money to the same older landlords who criticize them.
* Workers under the age of 25 are legally paid a lower minimum wage than older adults, earning much less money for doing the exact same jobs.
* In addition to lower pay, young workers are also much more likely to be stuck in insecure jobs with no guaranteed working hours.
